subject: session date
fact: The events occur on the 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493.
source_quote: 1st day of the 3rd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is upset that the person he has known for a day is dead.
source_quote: I am so upset that the person I have known for a day is dead!

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait screams at Jimjar to give him money so he can leave.
source_quote: Give me money. I am leaving now!

subject: Jimjar reassures Spiderbait
fact: Jimjar reassures Spiderbait that he is more likely to live if he stays around.
source_quote: he’s more likely to live if he stays around

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wakes from a dream about what monks dream about and stands ready to kill.
source_quote: Zalthir, whose pleasant dream about what Monks dream about was interrupted, looks around, trying to figure out why everyone is in an uproar. Then, hearing the screaming, he stands to attention, ready to kill.

subject: Yukyuk's murder
fact: Yukyuk was murdered.
source_quote: Yukyuk was murdered

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar whispers to others that Yukyuk was murdered and Spiderbait is upset.
source_quote: No. Yukyuk was murdered, and Spiderbait is very upset.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says the group has no option but to continue and be alert.
source_quote: Well, we have no other option but to continue and be alert.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wants to figure out what happened to Yukyuk.
source_quote: I want to figure out what happened.

subject: Daz questions Spiderbait about Yukyuk
fact: Daz asks Spiderbait if anyone would want Yukyuk dead.
source_quote: Would anyone want him dead?

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait says Yukyuk was the kindest, gentlest goblin he knew and that they were pals.
source_quote: Yukyuk was the kindest, gentlest goblin you could imagine. He and I were pals.

subject: Spiderbait accuses Shuushar
fact: Spiderbait accuses Shuushar of murdering Yukyuk, claiming Kuo-toans go mad and kill.
source_quote: I’ll tell you who I think it is - Shuushar. Kuo-toan’s go mad. And when they go mad, they snap, and then they kill people!

subject: Daz lists suspects
fact: Daz lists Buppido, Sethir, Topsy and Turvy, Jimjar, Eldeth, and Shuushar as suspects with notable traits.
source_quote: Buppido always talks about the divine plan. Sethir seems a bit off. Topsy and Turvy are lycanthropes. Jimjar makes bets all the time. Eldeth is trying to keep it together and make sure we all arrive in one piece. And Shuushar claims to have figured out the cure to Kuo-toan insanity.

subject: Shuushar proposes trip to Sloobludop
fact: Shuushar proposes heading to Sloobludop to meet the arch-cleric of the Seamother to cast zone of truth.
source_quote: I propose we head to Sloobludop, where we can meet the arch-cleric of the Seamother, who can cast the zone of truth, and we can learn what happened.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum calls Shuushar’s proposal the easy way out and prefers deduction.
source_quote: That’s the easy way out. Let’s do it the hard way by applying intelligence, deduction, insight, and perception.

subject: Daz questions Buppido
fact: Daz asks Buppido if he knows what happened to Yukyuk.
source_quote: Do you know what happened?

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says Yukyuk’s death was part of the divine plan.
source_quote: This was all part of the plan!

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says Yukyuk’s death was necessary for the divine plan.
source_quote: Yukyuk’s death was necessary for the divine plan.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido refuses to say who is responsible for Yukyuk’s death, claiming he cannot be held accountable.
source_quote: Who can say? I cannot be held accountable for the divine plan.

subject: Buppido's shortsword
fact: Daz notices blood on Buppido's shortsword.
source_quote: the shortsword may have blood on it from a victim

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido protests that the blood on his shortsword is not from murder, saying he’s not a maid.
source_quote: I’m not a maid, and that’s why it’s got blood on it.

subject: Daz casts mind-sliver on Buppido
fact: Daz casts a mind-sliver on Buppido and demands answers.
source_quote: Daz ... casts a mind-sliver on the derro, stares him in the eye, and makes it clear that it could get a lot worse.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido cries out that the mind-sliver hurt and claims it wasn't him.
source_quote: Ouch!! That hurt. It wasn’t me!

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido says the agent of the divine plan was responsible for Yukyuk’s death.
source_quote: It was the agent of the divine plan.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'That’s what they all say.'
source_quote: That’s what they all say.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido whimpers that it’s not his fault.
source_quote: It’s not my fault,

subject: Daz casts second mind-sliver on Buppido
fact: Daz casts another mind-sliver on Buppido, causing him to whimper more.
source_quote: Another mind-sliver is cast, and the derro whimpers even more.

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith praises Daz’s technique and offers more effective torture methods from Lolth’s guard.
source_quote: That’s an excellent torturing technique. However, I have other more effective ones that I was taught as a member of Lolth’s guard. We could remove his eyes, nails, and other things.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says he is not torturing Buppido, but providing motivation.
source_quote: I am not torturing him; I am providing motivation.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is intrigued by the term 'motivation' for torture and considers reconsidering his prohibition of it.
source_quote: Perhaps I should reconsider my prohibition of it.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido continues to deny responsibility for Yukyuk’s death.
source_quote: It wasn’t me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz concludes that Buppido is mad, not merely different in perspective.
source_quote: Buppido is mad.

subject: Daz orders Buppido tied up
fact: Daz orders Buppido to be tied up and gagged if he cannot stay quiet.
source_quote: We are going to tie you up, and if you can’t keep quiet, gag you.

subject: Buppido is gagged and tied
fact: A few minutes later, Buppido is gagged and walks next to Shuushar.
source_quote: A few minutes later, a gagged Buppido walks next to Shuushar

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar talks endlessly about Kuo-toan-fulness to Buppido.
source_quote: Shuushar, who talks endlessly about this technique called Kuo-toan-fulness.

subject: Shuushar describes Kuo-toan-fulness
fact: Shuushar describes Kuo-toan-fulness as creating space between impulse and action to discern if it is a reaction or a mental response.
source_quote: the goal is to create a space between the moment an impulse comes to your mind and the moment you take an action, and in that moment, wonder if that impulse is a reaction to the real world or just a response in your mind.

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido pleads for a mercy killing while gagged.
source_quote: Buppido pleads for a mercy killing

subject: Buppido's muffled moans
fact: All that can be heard from Buppido are muffled moans.
source_quote: all that everyone can hear is the muffled moans
